description.narrative: Expected project level outcomes: Access to venture capital in Pakistan has grown in recent years but remains some of the lowest across emerging markets. As such, IFC expects the project level outcomes to include increased access to early-stage venture capital alongside operational value add for tech startups in Pakistan. This will help scale innovative digital business models and bring more businesses and consumers online to expand the digital economy. Expected market creation: IFC expects that the Fund, as the one of the only experienced and scaled fund manager in the market, will increase competitiveness of the emerging but nascent VC market in Pakistan. The Fund is also involved in several VC ecosystem building activities that are expected to have network effects in improving the pipeline of investable startups, which is a critical enabler to generating a viable VC funds market

IFC equity investment of up to $10m in Techxila Fund II L.P., managed by Fatima Gobi Ventures (Fatima Gobi Fund II, Fund II, the Fund or FGV II), a Mauritius domiciled Venture Capital (VC) fund that will invest in Tech Start-ups primarily in Pakistan.
